precepts.why:
“For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people.” Mordecai sought the welfare of his people, as Nehemiah did. The Most High always raises up that spark in our brothers to rise up and seek the welfare of their people.

That is why Esau sits around finding ways to give us drugs, crack and cocaine, and to destroy our families and our minds through trauma: so that kind of man will not rise again. The Esthers, the Judiths, the Susannas, the Rebekahs, Shiphrah and Puah: they cannot be allowed to live. But they have all come back. If we are back, they are back, and the nations know it.

points: The king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land and upon the isles of the sea, and all the acts of his power and might, with the declaration of the greatness of Mardocheus whereunto the king advanced him, are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia.
